[EN] [Important] Rescue Mission

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Stay safe."
[ES] "Mantente a salvo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Amarre at the path to the prison.
[ES] Habla con Amarre en el camino hacia la prisión.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Prison
[ES] Prisión

[ES] "Está bien."

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[ES] Entra al centro de interrogatorios.

[EN] "Okay."

[EN] "Let's go."

[ES] Salida de la prisión

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[ES] Salta al agujero junto a Titus y encuentra la salida de la prisión.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Remove the boulders and escape.
[ES] Quita las rocas y escapa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Yes."
[ES] "Sí."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
